title: Christmas Light Installation
shortDescription: Custom-designed, professional-grade LED Christmas light installation for homes and businesses across the GTA — fully managed from design to takedown.
longDescription: Brighten up your home or business with our professional Christmas light installation. We create dazzling displays tailored to your property's roofline, trees, columns, and walkways. Send a photo of your home for a free quote — we'll design, install, maintain, take down, and store your lights at the end of January.
imageAlt: Professional Christmas light installation by GTA Christmas Lighting on a GTA home

title: Holiday Lighting Installation
shortDescription: Custom lighting for every holiday — Diwali, Hanukkah, Christmas, and beyond. Festive displays tailored to your celebration and your property.
longDescription: Celebrate every holiday with custom-designed lighting. From the warm glow of Diwali diyas to bright Hanukkah candles to Christmas wonderlands, we install festive displays for any occasion. Fully managed: we plan, install, maintain, and remove — you simply enjoy.
imageAlt: Custom holiday lighting installation for Diwali, Hanukkah, and Christmas by GTA Christmas Lighting

title: Permanent Lighting Installation
shortDescription: Year-round LED accent lighting for your home or business — programmable colours, holiday-ready presets, no seasonal install required.
longDescription: Permanent LED lighting on your eaves gives you Christmas mode at the tap of a button — plus accent lighting for every holiday, game day, and special occasion the rest of the year. Tasteful daytime profile, vibrant night-time options, app-controlled scenes, and no annual install fees.
imageAlt: Permanent LED lighting installation on a GTA home by GTA Christmas Lighting

title: Tree Lighting
shortDescription: Illuminate outdoor trees with stunning even-cast displays — wrapped spruces, lit canopies, and showcase entrance trees.
longDescription: We bring outdoor trees to life with custom tree lighting. From small front-yard spruces wrapped branch-by-branch to oversized estate-property trees with thousands of bulbs, we design and install displays that compliment the natural shape of each tree.
imageAlt: Outdoor tree lighting installation by GTA Christmas Lighting on a residential property

title: Interior Decorations
shortDescription: Wreaths, garlands, mantel styling, and seasonal interior touches — bring the festive spirit inside.
longDescription: Christmas trees, mantel garlands, banister wraps, oversized wreaths, table-scapes, and statement pieces. Our interior team styles your home for the holidays with a designer's eye and a white-glove install.
imageAlt: Interior Christmas decorations and wreaths by GTA Christmas Lighting in a Toronto home

title: Custom Displays
shortDescription: One-of-a-kind lighting tailored to your style — from refined warm white to full multi-colour signature looks.
longDescription: Have a specific vision in mind? Our designers will bring it to life. Custom-cut lights to your roofline, custom-coloured bulbs, special-occasion themed designs, and entirely bespoke installations. We've decorated film sets, restaurants, hospitals, and homes that draw crowds of admirers.
imageAlt: Custom Christmas lighting display by GTA Christmas Lighting on a residential home at night

title: Commercial Light Installation
shortDescription: Storefronts, hotels, restaurants, municipalities, and parks — large-scale holiday lighting that attracts customers and energizes spaces.
longDescription: Eye-catching displays for storefronts, festive lighting for municipalities, hotels, restaurants, condo lobbies, and parks. We handle commercial-grade installations with the right safety equipment, after-hours scheduling, and customized designs that scale to your property.
imageAlt: Commercial Christmas light installation for a GTA business by GTA Christmas Lighting
